title: Model foundation and deterministic gateway

steps.title: Adapt registered actions into bounded model proposals
deliverables: Reuse the durable action schema for ActionProposal version 1, adding model response framing, proposal bounds, purpose, information needs, expected observations, criteria, and resource class.
Bind action-specific arguments, dependencies, preconditions, stop conditions, and controller identity echoes to the existing action registry rather than defining competing execution records.

Define a bounded predicate language and fail-closed evaluator over known task, repository, and environment fields, returning satisfied, unsatisfied, or unknown without executing arbitrary expressions.
acceptance: Valid repository inspection, memory lookup, external search, example lookup, experiment, and implementation proposals deserialize through their declared action schemas.
Unknown action discriminators, malformed or excessive proposals, and unknown predicate fields or operators fail validation or yield an explicit unknown result; no tool is invoked.
steps.notes: Render only the relevant registered type and tool subset for the small reasoner, while keeping complete catalogs queryable. No model invents a registry term or callable tool.
steps.implemented_scope: Bounded model proposal framing, installed-tool admission, identity/reference checking and tri-state predicates.

steps.title: Connect typed coding handoffs to model output
deliverables: Connect the existing ImplementationContract to reasoner generation and coder rendering, preserving task revision, subgoal, base, environment, scope, compatibility, evidence, assumptions, and verification criteria.

Adapt model responses into the existing CodingResult contract with invocation provenance, patch or inability, changed files, proposed checks, and raised information needs; retain scripted producer compatibility.
acceptance: Changing a handoff's required behavior or permitted scope creates a new immutable contract instead of mutating an existing assignment.
A result cannot claim both a successful patch and a classified inability; a focused information need is accepted without fabricating a patch or marking the task complete.
steps.implemented_scope: Existing immutable coding handoffs render to recipients; complete model results admit durably into existing coding records with focused information needs.
remaining: Generate new immutable implementation contracts from reasoner output.

steps.title: Add the recipient-specific context rendering interface
deliverables: Select mandatory task records and render them through deployment-specific tokenizer, chat, role, and response templates, reserving output space and exposing an optional-memory bundle interface.
Persist exact rendered input, ordered source references, template versions, tokenizer accounting, and the originating baseline knowledge view without requiring persistent-memory retrieval.
acceptance: The same authoritative input renders through two fixture tokenizers with different usable limits and produces independently reproducible packet records.

An overflowing optional bundle is omitted or narrowed with its reason recorded; mandatory requirements or an essential qualification are never silently truncated, and mandatory overflow returns context_overflow.
steps.notes: Retain explicit type/version and qualifier references in compact contexts; full semantic packet rendering is implemented separately in P197.
steps.implemented_scope: Task-aware exact recipient contexts, input/output accounting, source rehashing, persistence and whole optional memory/qualification bundles.

steps.title: Validate model envelopes and bound repair attempts
deliverables: Add constrained-output negotiation where supported and a validated envelope fallback where it is unavailable.
Implement configurable bounded repair with separately recorded invocations, original output retention, and a terminal schema_violation classification after exhaustion.
acceptance: A malformed response followed by a valid repair produces one accepted proposal while preserving both raw outputs and their usage records.

An exhausted repair allowance, incomplete stream, or prose pretending to be an action produces no executable proposal; structurally valid responses remain untrusted until controller semantic validation.
steps.implemented_scope: Strict complete envelopes, output capability negotiation helper and bounded, separately retained and budgeted repairs in the offline gateway.

steps.title: Require atomic inference reservations before dispatch
deliverables: Wire generation, repair, and reviewer dispatch to the existing atomic ledger for token, inference-time, monetary, worker-slot, and applicable search allowances.
Require stable operation identities and successful task-wide reservations before model work enters a runnable queue; share aggregate capacity with tool and source operations.
acceptance: Two generation workers competing for the last available allowance cannot both dispatch; the rejected request records budget_unavailable without contacting the backend.

Replaying an identical reservation request returns its existing operation, while reusing its key with changed amounts fails; a cancelled queue entry releases capacity only through the defined ledger transition.
steps.implemented_scope: Stable operation identities and atomic task-ledger reservations before fixture generation, repair or reviewer dispatch.

steps.title: Prepare a reproducible inference host profile
deliverables: A documented local runtime or configured endpoint profile with backend version, model access, weight/tokenizer revisions, available devices, and secret references.
A preflight command checking connectivity or loading feasibility and producing resource observations without marking the deployment qualified.
acceptance: The chosen host can serve one pinned deployment or returns an explicit resource/access blocker, with all configuration needed for a later live run recorded.
A missing weight revision, inaccessible endpoint, or insufficient host capacity cannot silently select another model or claim conformance.
steps.implemented_scope: Pinned local host profile, file/template/backend checks and read-only CPU feasibility observations.
remaining: Supervised real model loading and connectivity/access qualification.
Actual GPU observations through a device adapter.

steps.title: Enforce provider destination and disclosure policies
deliverables: A shared outbound policy for search, document fetch, remote inference, and embeddings, checking destination, authorized data classes, request content, and secret references before transport.
A recorded allow, sanitized-allow, or deny decision linked to the task capability context and the effective request.
acceptance: A protected repository excerpt or canary secret in a denied request never reaches a local fake provider; an allowed sanitized request records exactly what was disclosed.
Changing source text or model-proposed arguments cannot widen destination or disclosure authority; each redirect receives the same destination check.
steps.implemented_scope: Shared outbound destination and disclosure policy is reserved for the coordinated security boundary.
remaining: Shared policy and recorded decisions for real search, fetch, remote inference and embeddings.

steps.title: Implement streaming inference transport supervision
deliverables: Implement one backend adapter behind the common gateway, including streaming assembly, terminal usage, transport failures, deadlines, and cooperative cancellation.
Record backend capability limitations explicitly when cancellation or exact provider token usage is unavailable.
acceptance: Scripted fragmented responses produce the same final parsed output as an unfragmented response and persist exactly one terminal invocation record.

Cancellation and deadline fixtures stop delivery of usable proposals, retain partial output and incurred usage, and expose an indeterminate or unsupported stop outcome when the backend cannot confirm termination.
steps.implemented_scope: Finite offline streaming, deadlines and cooperative cancellation, raw output retention, lifecycle classification and conservative restart behavior.
remaining: Confirmed process termination for blocking runtimes.

steps.title: Settle gateway usage through the task budget ledger
deliverables: Translate gateway token reports, elapsed inference, loading, repair, failure, and reviewer usage into existing idempotent settlement operations; retain unresolved charges for interrupted calls.
Route background inference to its configured task or maintenance budget while preserving aggregate evaluation cost and provenance for estimated versus provider-reported usage.
acceptance: Duplicate completion delivery changes totals once; an ordinary completed operation releases its unused allowance and retains its actual usage.
A lost terminal usage report remains charged conservatively until reconciliation; an actual overrun stops further scheduling or marks exhaustion instead of creating extra available budget.
steps.implemented_scope: Idempotent fixture-usage settlement, exact synthetic input accounting, conservative held reservations and explicit reconciliation.
remaining: Loading transitions and background maintenance accounting.

steps.title: Separate deterministic gateway CI from live qualification
deliverables: Build reusable conformance fixtures for formatting, limits, streaming, cancellation, parser repair, evidence identifiers, unknown preconditions, and cross-model memory consumption.

Provide separate deterministic and opt-in live runners; live runs use normal gateway admission and usage settlement with a bounded qualification budget, bind results to complete deployment fingerprints, and can run one model at a time.
acceptance: Ordinary CI runs the fake backend without downloading weights, requiring credentials, or making network calls.
A skipped, unavailable, or partially completed live run cannot mark a deployment qualified; changing weights, tokenizer, quantization, or prompt adapter invalidates the applicable qualification.
steps.notes: Fixed weights are the baseline. Any later trained deployment requires this qualification plus the separate training and release gates.
steps.implemented_scope: Deterministic gateway CI and documented live conformance inventory are present; fixtures cannot qualify deployments.
remaining: Opt-in budgeted live qualification runner bound to complete deployment fingerprints.

steps.title: Qualify the Phi-4-mini-instruct reasoning adapter
deliverables: Implement microsoft/Phi-4-mini-instruct formatting and its configured tool or envelope protocol using the exact tokenizer and deployment revision.
Produce a live conformance report for bounded reasoning output, effective context limits, and consumption of evidence attributed to another model.
acceptance: The actual deployment returns a valid focused question, typed action, and bounded implementation contract on finite programming fixtures while preserving supplied evidence identifiers.
Malformed output or an unknown precondition is rejected or repaired within the configured allowance; an oversized mandatory packet fails locally before inference.
steps.implemented_scope: Phi-4-mini-instruct advisory profile and exact-tokenizer rendering interface.
remaining: All actual Phi-4-mini-instruct load/generation and cross-model live qualification.

steps.title: Qualify the Gemma 3 4B IT reasoning adapter
deliverables: Implement google/gemma-3-4b-it text-mode rendering, configured tokenizer and chat template, and a qualified structured envelope without assuming another model's tool protocol.
Record a live qualification report for the actual backend, precision, limits, and prompt version.
acceptance: The actual deployment produces a valid information need, action, and implementation contract and uses a fixture memory authored by another reasoner without losing its version qualification.
A missing evidence identifier or unsupported precondition cannot reach execution, and configured context overflow is detected without dropping mandatory task requirements.
steps.implemented_scope: Gemma 3 4B IT text-mode advisory profile and first-user-turn controller instruction policy.
remaining: All actual Gemma 3 4B IT load/generation and cross-model live qualification.

steps.title: Qualify the Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct coding adapter
deliverables: Implement Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct rendering and CodingResult parsing with its exact tokenizer and qualified usable context configuration.
Record live patch-generation and cross-model handoff results; longer-context configurations require their own qualification rather than inheriting support from the family name.
acceptance: On a tiny programming fixture, the actual deployment implements a reasoner-authored contract, returns an applicable patch, and passes the fixture's targeted verification.
An insufficient-scope fixture produces a classified inability or focused information need; a mismatched base reference or malformed patch never becomes an accepted candidate.
steps.implemented_scope: Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct advisory profile and shared coding result protocol.
remaining: All actual Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct load/generation and exact-base live qualification.

steps.title: Qualify the CodeGemma 7B IT coding adapter
deliverables: Implement google/codegemma-7b-it chat formatting and CodingResult adaptation with compact implementation packets and the configured tokenizer's measured limits.
Persist live qualification evidence for patch production, failure classification, and consumption of another model's bounded contract and memory references.
acceptance: The actual deployment returns an applicable patch for a tiny repository task and the resulting state passes the targeted fixture check.
An incomplete contract produces a focused question or classified inability; a packet exceeding usable context is rejected before inference rather than silently losing compatibility constraints.
steps.implemented_scope: CodeGemma 7B IT advisory profile and first-user-turn controller instruction policy.
remaining: All actual CodeGemma 7B IT load/generation and exact-base live qualification.

steps.title: Qualify the DeepSeek Coder V2 Lite coding adapter
deliverables: Implement deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct rendering and CodingResult adaptation for the exact backend, tokenizer, and precision.
Measure the complete deployment's resident and context-memory requirements and retain a live qualification report; active parameter count does not determine the loading budget.
acceptance: Running alone on an eligible host, the actual deployment consumes a cross-model contract, produces an applicable fixture patch, and passes targeted verification.
Insufficient device capacity is classified as model_unavailable or a resource failure, never algorithmic failure or successful qualification; invalid result references remain rejected.
steps.implemented_scope: DeepSeek Coder V2 Lite Instruct advisory profile and full-resident-allocation preflight requirements.
remaining: All actual DeepSeek Coder V2 Lite load/generation and exact-base live qualification.

steps.title: Schedule a logical ensemble on limited hardware
deliverables: Add physical admission using resident weights, context storage, runtime overhead, loading cost, device availability, and workspace leases.
Permit sequential model loading and prioritize foreground operations above compatible batched maintenance work.
acceptance: A scripted five-model portfolio completes with only one deployment resident at a time, preserving logical participation and charging load transitions.
A deployment that cannot fit waits, fails, or is explicitly skipped only under the permitted degradation profile; low-priority consolidation cannot repeatedly evict an active foreground model.
steps.implemented_scope: Physical multi-model admission, loading, eviction and residency scheduling remain pending.
remaining: Resource-aware sequential residency and charging load transitions.
Foreground priority and bounded maintenance admission.

scope_definition: Implemented status means the stated deterministic model-foundation deliverables are present. This milestone performs no live model inference and does not complete Phase 5.
concurrent_work_boundaries: Preserve existing SYN/synny resolution and semantic registries; source declarations retain versions and qualification references with syntax-only provenance.
No SQL migration or embedding-space change.
Credential store, startup launchers, private cryptographic broker and MCP transports are unchanged.
Use an incremental Phase 4 patch; overlapping edits fail the Git apply check.
next_work: Coordinate the outbound destination/disclosure policy with the private-keystore architecture.
Implement one supervised local inference adapter and bounded live qualification runner.
Qualify the five exact deployments individually, then add physical residency scheduling.
